operators.notes: Scan 25-row nation table, dictionary-encoded n_name, extract single n_nationkey for GERMANY

Iterate all 100K entries in shared supplier hash, filter by s_nationkey matching GERMANY. Collect qualifying s_suppkey values into a bitset indexed by suppkey (max_key=100000). Bitset is 12.5KB — fits in L1 cache.

simultaneous_total.name: total_value
simultaneous_total.notes: Accumulate grand total alongside per-group aggregation in same pass — eliminates subquery

operators.notes: Single-pass fused scan+probe+aggregate over partsupp. For each row, probe bitset on ps_suppkey; if hit, multiply ps_supplycost*ps_availqty and add to direct_array[ps_partkey] AND to running total. This computes both the main query and subquery in one pass.
Scan aggregation array, emit groups where value exceeds threshold. Expected ~1K qualifying groups for SF10 with GERMANY.
Sort ~1K rows by value descending. Trivial cost — std::sort suffices.

german_suppkey_set.notes: Indexed by s_suppkey (dense PK, max 100000). 12.5KB fits in L1 cache for fast probe during partsupp scan.

partkey_agg_array.notes: ps_partkey is dense FK (max 2M). Direct array = 16MB, fits in L3. Zero-initialized; non-zero entries after scan are the groups. Avoids hash table overhead entirely.

total_accumulator.notes: Running sum for the HAVING threshold subquery, accumulated in same pass as per-group aggregation.

partsupp_scan.notes: Each of 16 threads gets a thread-local 16MB direct_array + local total_value scalar. After scan completes, merge 16 arrays element-wise (16 * 16MB = 256MB total, well within memory). 16 threads chosen over 64 to balance parallelism vs merge cost and memory footprint.

having_sort.notes: Post-aggregation HAVING filter + sort over ~1K rows — single-threaded is optimal.

subquery_elimination.notes: The HAVING subquery computes the same join chain (partsupp ⋈ supplier ⋈ nation WHERE GERMANY) with a global SUM. Instead of executing it separately, the grand total is accumulated as a side-effect of step 3's scan, eliminating a redundant 8M-row pass.
